recognize_zh: 大型淋巴球有豐富的淡藍色細胞質，邊緣呈深藍色並「擁抱」鄰近紅血球（Downey II 型），核染色質較鬆散，是反應性淋巴球的典型樣貌。
features: Large lymphocytes with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and a deeper basophilic rim at the periphery
Cytoplasmic borders indented by and scalloping around adjacent red cells (Downey type II)
Round to oval nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Background red cells normocytic; no blasts or smudge cells in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large lymphocytes with abundant pale blue cytoplasm that deepens in basophilia toward the periphery and scallops around adjacent red cells. Nuclei are round to oval with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Red cells appear normocytic, and no blasts or smudge cells are seen. Findings are consistent with reactive (atypical) lymphocytes, as seen in infectious mononucleosis and other viral infections.

ddx.vs: Blasts have a high N:C ratio, fine immature chromatin and scant cytoplasm, whereas reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm with mature chromatin.
Lymphoma cells form a monotonous population with irregular or cleaved nuclei and are clonal by flow cytometry, whereas reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm without the peripheral basophilic rim hugging red cells.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin, a perinuclear hof and uniformly deep blue cytoplasm.
